sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain unbeaten over their previous four outings (W-D-W-W), and face an Alsager side struggling at the foot of the league with just 4 points from 10 games. This should represent a solid opportunity for the leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: The title race tightens as second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host struggling Dawley Town, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in a mid-table contest. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community (currently 9th with 13 points) in a fixture that could shift the upper-table dynamics. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) play Foley Meir at home in a mid-table clash, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter in alarming form with six consecutive defeats. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-six battle, Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a lower-table encounter, and Brereton Social (14th) face Widnes Town (bottom, just 2 points), the division's weakest side. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a battle of struggling teams. A midweek fixture sees Brereton Social visit Brereton Social to face Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
